findings.body:
**Dissociate borrowed objects when creating the clone.**

If `repoRoot` uses an alternate object store, `src/ops/review/addressMany.ts:133` creates another clone that borrows from that store. `--no-hardlinks` does not remove this dependency. Removing the reference repository or pruning required objects can then break active or preserved clones. Git documents `--dissociate` for this case. Add it so clones containing unpushed fixes remain independent. ([git-scm.com](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-clone/2.46.0))
findings.title: Dissociate borrowed objects when creating the clone.

findings.body:
**Treat unmeasured provider usage as unknown in the admission settlement.**

`src/ops/review/addressMany.ts:541-557` marks a leg as known when its settled `report.usage` is numeric. The check does not use the leg's usage provenance. `src/ops/review/address.ts:992-1009` adds each dispatch's `result.usage` to `report.usage` even when the provider supplied no measurement. Only the ledger observation at `address.ts:1005-1008` drops unmeasured usage. The consumer ignores that ledger.

A leg with an unmeasured dispatch can therefore produce zero or partial numeric totals that the consumer treats as complete. The known settlement at `addressMany.ts:592-600` then sums those totals, so the reservation can be refunded and a later candidate admitted while the spend is unrecorded. The same risk applies to a thrown dispatch: `address.ts:1250` records an unknown observation but adds no totals to `report.usage`.

Derive known-ness from the report's `usageSummary` (`address.ts:698`), which carries the unknown observations, or treat any leg with an unknown dispatch as unknown. Keep the `known` settlement for legs whose totals are fully measured.
findings.title: Treat unmeasured provider usage as unknown in the admission settlement.

findings.body:
**Forward the supported submission metadata.**

In `src/ops/review/submit.ts:158`, the new wire omits `i.task`, `i.branch`, `i.predecessor` and `i.observed`. Both `SubmitInputSchema` and `WireSchema` support these fields. A caller can supply them successfully, but persistence and `client.request(wire)` silently discard them.

Copy each defined field into the wire before validation and persistence.
findings.title: Forward the supported submission metadata.
Keep the persisted snapshot policy when a concurrent submission reuses the request ID.
